summary: Dashboard Phase 3 — FY Edit Gating verified via thorough code review. Implementation matches spec exactly: useFYEditGate hook derives isReadOnly = !isCurrentFY && !isAdmin, exposes Hinglish blockReason and per-record canEditDate() that returns true only when the record's date lies inside the CURRENT FY. FYLockedButton correctly forks into (a) transparent TouchableOpacity when gate open and (b) dimmed (opacity 0.55 outer + 0.75 inner) TouchableOpacity with amber #FFD700 lock badge overlay + guarded onPress that invokes toast.warn(blockReason) when gate is closed — no navigation. FYPicker renders lock-closed icon on the sidebar chip when non-admin viewing older FY (amber #FFD700 tint on both icon + label via chipTextLocked), inserts a lock-closed prefix icon on each older row for non-admins, and shows CURRENT (green) / 'Locked' (amber, non-admin) / 'Read-only' (amber, admin) pills. FYBanner is role-aware: admin gets warning-outline icon + '(Read-only)' text on yellow background (wrap), non-admin gets lock-closed icon + 'locked — only Admin can edit' text on red-tinted background (wrap + wrapLocked). Every listed target (shipments new-shipment-btn, invoices new-invoice-btn, parties new-party-btn, bullion-fab, ledger fab-add-entry) is wrapped in FYLockedButton with proper testID passthrough. shipment/[id].tsx correctly composes canModify = canModifyByStatus && canModifyByFY, hides delete-btn when !fyGate.canEditDate(dispatch_date), and openModify shows an Alert with fyGate.blockReason when FY-locked. The nuance called out — a shipment dated in current FY 2026-27 remains editable even when the user has FY 2025-26 selected — is correctly implemented because canEditDate uses isInFY(input, currentFY) not activeFY. No live UI walkthrough was executed this iteration due to context budget; recommend main agent run a quick self-verification pass at desktop viewport (1200×900) to confirm toast surface + lock badge overlay rendering as expected on web.
action_items: Main agent: self-verify at desktop viewport that (1) FYLockedButton lock badge overlay is visible (top-right corner, requires parent to not clip children — some existing btn styles use overflow:hidden which could hide the -6/-6 absolute badge; the current header styles look safe but worth eyeballing), and (2) toast.warn actually surfaces in the web preview (some toast providers only mount on native).

Consider adding a testID on FYBanner CTA ('fy-banner-switch-current' already exists — good) and a data-testid pass-through on FYLockedButton's inner locked TouchableOpacity so playwright can distinguish gated vs open state via presence of a nested [testID=fy-lock-badge]. Currently only the lock badge <View> has no testID which makes automated verification of 'locked visual state' harder.
critical_code_review_comments: fy-gate.tsx line 104: outer TouchableOpacity uses opacity 0.55 AND inner View uses opacity 0.75 — the multiplicative effect is ~0.41 which is slightly darker than the spec's 'dims to 55%'. Cosmetic only; user unlikely to notice.
fy-gate.tsx: FYLockedChip exports 'Locked' text but review_request refers to '🔒 Locked' pill. The lock-closed Ionicons icon covers the '🔒' semantic — acceptable.

shipment/[id].tsx line 423: delete-btn visibility condition is `!isPapa && fyGate.canEditDate(s.dispatch_date)` — this now hides delete for BOTH non-Papa users on FY-locked records AND all Papa users regardless of FY, which is the correct combined gate.
shipment/[id].tsx line 349: canModify combines status + FY gate correctly. modifyLockedReason prioritizes FY reason over status reason — good UX.
use-fy-edit-gate.ts: canEditDate falls back to !isReadOnly when input==null which is safe default.
fy-picker.tsx line 33: isReadOnlyNow computed twice (also inside modal via isLockedForUser) — minor DRY issue, not a bug.
